title: Ultrasound exams
subtitle: Reception places the order → patient pays at the cashier → the sonographer performs the exam, enters the report, and prints it.
flowHint: Unpaid orders are visible to the ultrasound doctor, but the exam can start only after full payment.
emptyHint: Create a new order from reception or change the filter.
attachmentsHint: Upload device images, PDFs or scans. Files are also stored in the patient folder.
